$comment: Test-only theme: the bare skin (body class skin-bare), which has no rules and no folder of its own, so every window shows the stock components on its modern layout, with the bare palette (theme-bare: the dark palette with these colors changed, so a snapshot shows the palette applied). tools/nui_skin_bare.py adds it to a scratch copy of assets/nui/nui for nui_skin_bare_test.py; it is never in the shipped nui/theme/themes.json. docs/ui/AUTHORING.md, Adding a theme.
